videos.title: YouTube video URLs or IDs
videos.description: Watch URLs, youtu.be links, Shorts, live or embed URLs, or bare 11-character video IDs.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Language codes in priority order, e.g. en, es, de. If none match, the first available transcript is returned.

translateTo.title: Translate to (optional)
translateTo.description: Language code to auto-translate the transcript into using YouTube's translation, e.g. en.

preferManual.title: Prefer human-made captions
preferManual.description: Use manually created captions over auto-generated ones when both exist.

includeSegments.title: Include timed segments
includeSegments.description: Add an array of segments with start time and duration.

includeSrt.title: Include SRT subtitles
includeSrt.description: Add an SRT subtitle file as a string.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave off to use our built-in residential proxy, included in the price. Set your own only if you want to.
